اعتمرن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرْنَ (iʕtamarna) /iʕ.ta.mar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرْنَ (uʕtumirna) /uʕ.tu.mir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اِعْتَمِرْنَ (iʕtamirna) /iʕ.ta.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
